When a session finishes, hits an error, asks you a questi"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"on, or needs your permission, you get a heads-up: a sound plays, and when you step away from the tab"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" a system notification keeps you in the loop."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"| The settings panel with the **Notifications** entry in the sidebar and the section content | The s"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ound picker for each kind (the official dropdown) |"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Everything lives in this plugin — no harness (host) changes:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- The settings section is registered through the client slot system (`settings.section`), exactly li"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ke official sections.

(dsh 0.1.7 derives plugin c"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"onfig forms from Loader entries, so the node half has no namespace to reserve and stays inert.)
- Th"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"e settings shell maps only its own section ids to nav icons, so the Notifications nav row shows the "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"shell's default gear."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## The four notification kinds"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Kind | When it fires | Default sound |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Session completed | A turn ends normally (`turn/end` completed) | chime |
| Session failed | A tur"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"n breaks with an error, or the host reports an agent error | fault |
| Question asked | The agent is"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" waiting for your answer (`question/requested`) | pop |
| Permission requested | The agent requests "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"an authorized operation (`approval/requested`) | alert |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Each kind can be enabled or disabled and reassigned to any of the four built-in sound effects (or mu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ted). The four sounds are synthesized with Web Audio — no audio files are shipped — and the master v"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"olume is adjustable with the official-style slider (0–100%). A fixed loudness boost (~+6 dB) with a "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"soft limiter on the playback chain makes every sound noticeably louder without distortion; custom au"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"dio feeds the same chain. Custom files are stored browser-"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"locally (they are device media, not shared preferences)."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Browser notifications & the quiet default"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Browser (system-level) notifications are **off by default**; turning the switch on asks for the brow"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ser's permission first (a user gesture). [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The browser half watches the sessions list snapshot and each session's conversation snapshot — no po"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"lling, no new wire channels:"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- A session's `running` edge true→false ends a run; the run is classified **failed** when a new `tur"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"n-error` node or a host `agent-error` appeared during it, otherwise **completed** (a failure that a "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"retry recovered reads as completed).
- A completion raises nothing while the host still has work tha"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"t will start another turn by itself (a queued follow-up, or a goal round the driver still owes): tha"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"t idle edge is a pause, and the continuation's own end notifies. A completed or failed notice is tit"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"led by the run's latest user message, falling back to the session title.
- A pending-interaction edg"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"e (`question` / `approval`) raises the question / permission kinds, with the question text or the to"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ol name+reason in the notification body.
- Sessions already idle (or already pending) when the plugi"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"n loads raise nothing."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- Failure detection reads the conversation snapshot, which the client only maintains for sessions th"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"at have been opened; a session that runs without ever being opened notifies as completed even on fai"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"lure.
- Browser notifications require permission, and sound playback requires the page to have user "},{"id":"p31s4","text":"activation (the browser's autoplay policy) — both are normal for browser apps and resolve as soon as"},{"id":"p31s5","text":" the user interacts with the GUI.
- Custom audio files live in the browser (localStorage), so they d"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"o not follow you across browsers or profiles.
- The browser half is event-driven from the sessions l"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"ist; it does not observe the raw event stream, so a run that starts and finishes between two list sn"},{"id":"p31s8","text":"apshots could in principle be missed (the host sends a status flip per edge, so this does not happen"},{"id":"p31s9","text":" in practice).
- Goal *activation* is process-local and never on the wire: a goal left `active` but "},{"id":"p31s10","text":"disarmed (for example after a restart) reads as a continuation, so its idle edge stays unannounced u"},{"id":"p31s11","text":"ntil the goal changes or is resumed.
- Background-job rosters are loaded only for the session you ar"},{"id":"p31s12","text":"e viewing, so a job that finishes and wakes an idle session is invisible to the client at that idle "},{"id":"p31s13","text":"edge; such a wake can still produce an early completion notice."}],"truncated":true}
